name: read-free
description: Chrome extension: swap a paywalled NYT article for the text of its newest archive.today snapshot.

scripts.check: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json', 'utf8'))" && for f in extension/*.js extension/src/*.js extension/options/*.js extension/popup/*.js extension/give/*.js extension/ui/*.js extension/welcome/*.js extension/health/*.js extension/page/*.js extension/sites/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
